source: 585 Repeated “Betrayal”
target: 585 Repetuta “Proditio”

source: 585 Repeated “Betrayal”
target: 585 Repetuta “Proditio”

source: At a distance of just over ten meters, the Pride Armor covered the ground in two powerful strides, positioning itself in front of Ultraman Lato Guiaro.
target: Ad spatium paulo ultra decem metra, armatura Superbia duobus validis gressibus terram tegebatur atque se ante Ultraman Lato Guiaro constituit.

source: A broadsword, condensed from radiant light, slashed down with deadly precision.
target: Ensis latum, ex luce radiante condensatus, cum letali subtilitate deorsum secabat.

source: Lato Guiaro had a momentary opportunity to utilize his Navigator ability, escape through hidden passageways in the void and dimensions, and evade the impending attack.
target: Lato Guiaro occasionem momentaneam habuit ut facultatem Navigatoris suam uteretur, per arcana itinera in vacuo atque in dimensionibus effugeret et impetum imminentem evitaret.

source: However, the sight of the silver-white full-body armor caught him off guard; he hadn’t anticipated an aggressive move before Lumian Lee could even don the armor!
target: Attamen, conspectus armaturae totius corporis argenteo-albinae eum inopinato percutiit; non praevidebat motum aggressivum antequam Lumian Lee armaturam indueret!

source: This momentary hesitation cost him.
target: Haec momentanea haesitatio ei pretium attulit.

source: The silver-white full-body armor, resembling a relentless steam locomotive, collided with him before he could vanish into the hidden tunnel.
target: Armatura totius corporis argenteo-albina, instar locomotivae vaporis inexorabilis, cum eo concurrit, priusquam in tunnello abscondito evanescere posset.

source: By then, it was too late, and the looming threat of being cleaved apart became imminent—a grim fate of upper and lower halves separated.
target: Tunc iam sero erat, et imminens periculum dissectionis factus est—fatum crudele partium superiorum et inferiorum separatam imminens.

source: In this dire circumstance, he was no earthworm with regenerative abilities; his fate seemed sealed.
target: In his adversis condicionibus, non erat vermis terrenus cum facultate regenerandi; fatum eius clausum videbatur.

source: Facing the approaching silver-white armor and its raised broadsword of light, scales formed from starlight protruded from various parts of Lato Guiaro’s body.
target: Adspiciens armaturam argenteo-albinam appropinquantem et eius ensis lucis elevatus, squamae ex luce stellarum formatae ex variis partibus corporis Lato Guiaro eminere videbantur.

source: The air quivered around him, as if an invisible tide were roaring, amplifying the tension.
target: Aer circa eum tremuit, velut invisibilis aestus rugiret, tensionem amplificans.

source: As per the intel gathered on April Fool’s, the power derived from the “sea” without the Governor of the Sea’s authority corresponded to a Sequence 5 at most, known as Tidal Scholar—the current state of Lato Guiaro.
target: Secundum notitiam collectam die Aprilis Stultorum, vis ex mari sine auctoritate Gubernatoris Maris ad maximum Sequens V pertinere videbatur, nota ut Tidal Scholar—status praesentis Lato Guiaro.

source: Enveloped by an ethereal tide, Lato Guiaro swung his fist, resembling a colossal wave crashing down.
target: Aestu aetherio involutus, Lato Guiaro pugnum movit, instar undae ingentis deorsum ruentis.

source: Thud!
target: Tum!

source: His formidable punch collided with the side of the broadsword of light, forcefully diverting its trajectory.
target: Pugnus eius formidolosus cum latere ensis lucis concurrit, iter eius vehementer deviando.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian materialized behind him, left hand raised.
target: Simul, Lumian post eum apparuit, manu sinistra elevata.

source: Indeed! I knew you’d seize this chance to teleport behind me and launch a sneak attack! Lato Guiaro was ready.
target: Ita vero! Sciebam te hanc occasionem capturum esse ut post me translocaretur atque insidias inferret! Lato Guiaro paratus erat.

source: Evading the silver-white full-body armor’s second strike, he imbued the surroundings in a warm golden hue.
target: Evitans secundum ictum armaturae totius corporis argenteo-albinae, ambitum in calido aureo lumine imbuivit.

source: Purification Halo!
target: Aureola Purificationis!

source: As layers of golden light surged towards Lumian, he deftly twisted his left wrist.
target: Dum strati lucis aureae ad Lumian impetum fecerant, callide sinistrum articulum flexit.

source: Even before that, the silver-white Lie earring on his left earlobe emitted a subtle glow, revealing various blobs of light and colors on Ultraman’s body.
target: Etiam ante hoc, monile Lie, argenteo-album in lobulo auris sinistrae, subtiles fulgores edebat, variis globulis lucis et colorum in corpore Ultraman ostendentibus.

source: Among them, a golden ball emitted a warm glow—the representation of the Purification Halo ability.
target: Inter eos, globus aureus, calidum fulgoribus emittens, repraesentabat facultatem Aureolae Purificationis.

source: With a flick of his wrist, the golden ball detached from Ultraman’s body and swiftly flew to Lumian.
target: In ictu carpi, globus aureus a corpore Ultraman se divisit et celeriter ad Lumian volavit.

source: Steal!
target: Furare!

source: Lumian successfully “stole” Ultraman’s Purification Halo!
target: Lumian feliciter furtum perfecit Aureolae Purificationis Ultraman.

source: The number of times the Ring of the Sea Queen could “steal” after the standard process remained unknown to Lumian.
target: Numerus viciorum quibus Anulus Reginae Maris post rationem ordinariam furtari poterat, Lumiano ignotus manebat.

source: However, he was certain that Lie’s “stealing” effect persisted for half a month, unaffected by his “stealing” of the sea’s power.
target: Attamen, certus erat effectum furtandi Lie per dimidium mensis perseverare, nec affici a furtu potentiae maris.

source: After Lie’s transformation on the ancestral altar in Milo Village, Lumian diligently experimented with Steal, honing his proficiency to ensure he could deploy it effectively in critical moments.
target: Post transformationem Lie in altero maiorum apud Villam Milo, Lumian diligenter cum furtatione experimenta egit, peritiam suam exercens ut eam in momentis decisivis efficaciter adhibere posset.

source: Thus, he had become relatively adept at stealing and dispersing the power of the sea.
target: Ita, relativus peritus factus erat in furto et in divulgatione potentiae maris.

source: Simultaneously, Ultraman’s Beyonder powers of the Sun pathway were well-documented by the Tarot Club’s information, making Lumian fully aware of what he aimed to Steal this time.
target: Simul, potestas Ultraman Beyonder viae Solis a notitia Club Tarot clare descriptae erant, faciens Lumian plene conscius de eo quod hoc tempore furtum facere intendebat.

source: With a solid foundation in mysticism knowledge, he felt prepared.
target: Cum solidis fundamentis in mystica scientia, se paratum sensit.

source: However, the challenge lay in his lack of experience “stealing” a Priest of Light’s abilities.
target: Tamen, difficultas in eius inexperientia “furtandi” facultates Sacerdotis Lucis iacebat.

source: He feared that locating the corresponding symbols for Purification Halo and Holy Water Creation might take too long, leaving him vulnerable to Lato Guiaro’s attacks.
target: Timebat ne reperire symbola quae corresponderent ad Aureolam Purificationis atque ad creationem Aquae Sanctae nimis diu caperet, eum impetibus Lato Guiaro exposuens.

source: Anticipating the Pride Armor’s frontal assault, Lumian strategically teleported four to five meters behind Lato Guiaro, enticing him to use Purification Halo.
target: Praevidens impetum frontale armaturae Superbiae, Lumian cum ratione quattuor vel quinque metris post Lato Guiaro se translocavit, eum ad Aureolam Purificationis adhibendam invitatum.

source: The distinction between the abilities Lumian used and those he refrained from was clear, providing him with instant recognition.
target: Distinctio inter facultates quas Lumian adhibuerat et eas quas abstinuit perspicua erat, tribuens ei instan recognoscibilitatem.

source: Before initiating the teleport, he activated the Lie earring and raised his left hand, ensuring he didn’t linger in the dangerous area for a moment longer.
target: Antequam se translocare inciperet, monile Lie activavit et manum sinistram sublevavit, ut in regione periculosa non diutius maneret.

source: The Purification Halo, despite being “stolen,” persisted and continued to surge, enveloping Lumian.
target: Aureola Purificationis, quamvis “furtum” esset, perseveravit et fluebat, Lumian amplectens.

source: However, it didn’t reach its intended target.
target: Tamen, ad finem destinatum non pervenit.

source: A formidable formless force emanated from Lumian’s body, acting as a barrier that thwarted the encroaching halo.
target: Vis ingens sine forma e corpore Lumiani emanavit, fungens ut barriera quae aureolam imminientem coercebat.

source: The power of the sea!
target: Potentia maris!

source: You have the power of the sea, and so do I!
target: Tu potentiam maris habes, et ego quoque.

source: During the Steal process, Lumian had reserved a portion of the sea’s power for himself.
target: In processu furtandi, Lumian partem potentiae maris sibi reservaverat.

source: Although not on par with Ultraman’s, it proved sufficient to repel the Purification Halo for a brief moment.
target: Etsi non ad aequipollentiam Ultramanis, sufficiens erat ad repellendam Aureolam Purificationis per momentum breve.

source: Calmly activating the black mark on his right shoulder, Lumian vanished from the warm golden area, teleporting to the farthest corner from Lato Guiaro.
target: Calme maculam nigrum in humero dextro activans, Lumian regionem auream calidam reliquit et se translocavit ad remotissimam angulum a Lato Guiaro.

source: The Purification Halo pursued relentlessly, but it reached its limit, visibly weakening.
target: Aureola Purificationis pertinaciter insequebatur, sed ad finem suum pervenit, manifesto debilitata.

source: Reacting swiftly, Lumian harnessed the power of the sea once more, watching as the warm golden barrier rapidly dissipated.
target: Celeriter respondens, Lumian potentiam maris iterum adiunxit, spectans dum barriera aurea calida celeriter evanesceret.

source: Meanwhile, Lato Guiaro’s heart skipped a beat.
target: Interim, cor Lato Guiaro palpitavit.

source: Intuitively, he sensed the loss of his Purification Halo ability, suspecting it had been “stolen”!
target: Intuens, sensus amisisse facultatem Aureolae Purificationis eius percusso, suspiciens eam furtam esse!

source: Lumian Lee’s item with the Steal effect is still operational?
target: Num res Lumian Lee, quae effectum furtandi habet, adhuc operatur?

source: Lato Guiaro couldn’t dwell on it.
target: Lato Guiaro de ea diutius meditari non potuit.

source: Dodging the Pride Armor’s heavy slashes, he fell to the ground, rolling to evade the attacks.
target: Impugnata gravia ictuum armaturae Superbiae eludens, ad terram cecidit, volvens ut impetus effugeret.

source: Facing the sky, he raised his right hand, clenching it.
target: Ad caelo spectans, manum dextrem elevavit, eam stringens.

source: Pure and blazing sunlight condensed rapidly, forming a thick ray that struck the silver-white armor’s chest.
target: Lux pura atque fulgida celeriter condensata est, radium densum formans, quod pectus armaturae argenteo-albinae percussit.

source: It paused momentarily, unable to penetrate, only burning and dissolving into tottering black marks.
target: Momento subsedit, penetrare non valens, solum ardebant et in maculas nigras vacillantes dissolutae.

source: Witnessing this and recognizing Lumian Lee as his adversary, Ultraman Lato Guiaro entertained the idea of fleeing.
target: Hoc videns et Lumian Lee adversarium suum agnoscens, Ultraman Lato Guiaro consilium fugendi meditabatur.

source: He decided to disengage, cease the confrontation, and seek an escape route.
target: Constituit recedere, certamen finire, et viam evasionis quaerere.

source: At that critical moment, instead of launching a barrage of attacks, the Pride Armor shifted its focus toward Lumian.
target: Illo momento critico, potius quam multitudinem impetuum inferre, armatura Superbia attentionem suam in Lumian convertit.

source: Lumian, who had previously utilized Spirit World Traversal on the betrothal ship and within the hall, found himself affected once again by the Purification Halo.
target: Lumian, qui prius Spiritus Mundi Transitus in nave nuptiali atque in aula adhibuerat, se iterum ab Aureola Purificationis affectum invenit.

source: His spirituality teetered on the brink of depletion, leaving him visibly fatigued and weakened.
target: Spiritualitas eius in limine evanescence pendebat, eum palam fessum atque debilitatus relinquens.

source: Any ordinary human in such a state near the Pride Armor would face indiscriminate attacks.
target: Quisquis homo vulgaris in tali statu prope armaturam Superbiae esset, impetum indiscriminatum experiretur.

source: Wh… Lato Guiaro keenly perceived the shift in dynamics.
target: Heu… Lato Guiaro acerrime mutationem dynamicae sensit.

source: Though unaware of the specifics, he sensed an advantage.
target: Quamquam singularia ignorans, commodum sensibiliter percepit.

source: Rising abruptly, he directed his attention to Lumian.
target: Subito surgens, animum suum ad Lumian convertebat.

source: In the next instant, the Pride Armor raised its radiant broadsword and charged towards Lumian.
target: In momento proximo, armatura Superbia ensis lucidus elevatus est et in Lumian impetum fecit.

source: Haha, your Sealed Artifact has betrayed you! Lato Guiaro mocked internally as he closed in, intending to exploit the silver‑white full‑body armor’s attack to create Sun Holy Water and sprinkle it on Lumian Lee.
target: Haha, artifactum tuum sigillatum te prodidit! Lato Guiaro, interno risu irrisus, appropinquabat, studens impetum armaturae totius corporis argenteo‑albinae uti ad creandam Aquam Sanctam Solis et eam in Lumian Lee spargendam.

source: Undeterred, Lumian took a resolute step forward.
target: Intrepidus, Lumian firmiter gradum in antecessum fecit.

source: Tapping into his Ascetic powers, the accumulated strength and spirituality within his body surged, replenishing his drained spirit.
target: Ad potentiam asceticam accedens, vis ac spiritualitas in corpore eius congregatae effulsere, spiritum eius exhauritum reficientes.

source: His body underwent a sudden transformation, growing by seven to eight centimeters and bulking up by two sizes, causing his loosely fitting deputy host’s robe to strain.
target: Corpus eius subita mutazione transiit, crescens per septem ad octo centesimas et dupliciter ampliatus, ita vestimentum adiutorem eius laxius indutum ad tensionem ducens.

source: The advancing Pride Armor abruptly halted, pivoting to face Lato Guiaro, who had followed closely.
target: Armatura Superbia progrediens subito subsedit, convertens se ut Lato Guiaro aspiceret, qui proxime secutus erat.

source: Lato Guiaro’s pupils contracted, and an instant heaviness enveloped his body, bringing him to a natural halt.
target: Pupillae Lato Guiaro contraxerunt, et momento gravitas corpus eius obduxit, naturaliter cessare faciens.

source: Simultaneously, his gaze locked onto the unusually tall figure of Lumian Lee.
target: Simul, oculus eius in figuram insolitum altitudinis Lumian Lee incidit.

source: The enemy teleported right in front of him, mere inches away.
target: Hostis, solummodo paucis digitorum distant, ante eum se translocavit.

source: Their eyes locked, reflecting each other in an intense confrontation.
target: Oculi eorum se invicem constringebantur, inter se reflectentes in intensa contentionis imagine.

source: With a swift whoosh, Lumian swung his right hand, adorned with the Flog boxing gloves, through the air.
target: Velociter, cum subito sonitu, Lumian manum dextram – ornata manubris pugilisticis “Flog” – per aerem percussit.

source: Lato Guiaro’s “heavy” state naturally exerted a suction force on his surroundings, a downgraded version of the humanoid Sealed Artifact’s characteristic.
target: Status “gravis” Lato Guiaro in circumstantibus naturaliter vim aspirantem efferebat, versio minor propterius proprietatis artifacti sigillati humanoidis.

source: Lumian’s punch encountered no repulsion; instead, it accelerated towards its target.
target: Pugnus Lumiani nullam repulsionem obvenit; potius ad metam suam acceleravit.

source: Unperturbed by the close‑range attacks, Lato Guiaro harbored concerns about Lumian’s Psychic Piercing ability.
target: Nespertus ictibus proximis, Lato Guiaro sollicitudines de facultate psychica perforandi Lumiani gerebat.

source: Unable to dodge or employ other abilities in time, he unleashed a retaliatory fist resembling a thousand tonnes of seawater, causing the sound of surging tides to echo.
target: Non potens vitare vel alias facultates tempore adhibere, effudit pugnus retributionis, instar mille tonnorum aquae maris, cuius sonus fluctuum ruentium resonabat.

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lato Guiaro blocked Lumian’s attack and swiftly rolled to the side, evading a surprise assault from the Pride Armor.
target: Lato Guiaro impetum Lumiani obstrinxit et celeriter ad latus volvit, impetum improvisum ab armatura Superbia evitans.

source: At that moment, a strong sense of greed surged within him, overshadowing his initial plan to escape.
target: Illo momento, vehementer sensus avaritiae intra eum surrexit, primum consilium fugendi obumbrans.

source: Seizing the opportunity, Lumian retreated and retrieved a black bone flute with red holes from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Occasionem capiens, Lumian recedens ex sacculo itineris tibiam ossis nigrae cum foramina rubris extraxit.

source: Symphony of Hatred!
target: Symphonia Odii!

source: While Lato Guiaro resisted the Pride Armor, Lumian brought the flute to his mouth and played a sharp, intense melody.
target: Dum Lato Guiaro armaturam Superbiae repugnabat, Lumian tibiam ad os attulit et melodiam acutam atque intensam cecinit.

source: Lato Guiaro’s mind buzzed, freezing him in place.
target: Mens Lato Guiaro murmure pervagata, eum in loco immobilis relinquens.

source: Bright blood oozed from the cracks in the starlight scales on his body.
target: Sanguis lucidus ex fissuris in squamis stellae in corpore eius effluens erat.

source: Emotional Detonation!
target: Detonatio Affectuum!

source: Pfft! The Pride Armor struck Lato Guiaro’s shoulder, splintering scales, bone, and flesh.
target: Pfft! Armatura Superbia humerum Lato Guiaro percussit, scalas, ossa, et carnem dissecans.

source: Closing the distance with two brisk strides, Lumian approached the nearly collapsed Lato Guiaro, his face twisted in pain.
target: Duo rapidos gressus intervallum minuentes, Lumian Lato Guiaro, qui paene corruit, appropinquavit, facies dolore contorta.

source: He raised the black bone flute in his hand.
target: Tibiam ossis nigrae in manu attulit.

source: In the moment that Lato Guiaro used the pain from the Pride Armor strike to break free from the detonated emotions, he witnessed Lumian Lee thrusting the bone flute toward him with a fierce expression.
target: In illo momento, dum Lato Guiaro dolorem ictus armaturae Superbiae ad se liberandum ab affectibus detonatis adhibuit, vidit Lumian Lee tibiam ossis in se conicere, vultu ferocitate distincto.

source: Pfft!
target: Pfft!

source: The bone flute effortlessly pierced Lato Guiaro’s left eye, akin to cutting through butter.
target: Tibiam ossis sine labore penetravit oculum sinistrum Lato Guiaro, instar secandi butyrum.

source: The eyeball of April Fool’s key member exploded, and a gruesome mix of blood and other fluids streamed out through the gaps in the black bone flute.
target: Globus oculi membrum clavis Aprilis Stultorum explodit, et horrida miscella sanguinis atque aliorum fluidorum per fissuras in tibia ossis nigrae effluebat.

source: Even if the Symphony of Hatred only struck an ordinary part, it was tantamount to hitting a vital point.
target: Etiamsi Symphonia Odii tantum partem vulgare percussisset, id aequivalebat ictui puncti vitalis.

source: Striking a true vital point meant either instant death or a prolonged period of social death.
target: Percutere verum punctum vitale significabat aut mortem instantaneam aut longum spatium mortis socialis.

source: In this case, Lato Guiaro’s left eye and brain were undeniably vital points.
target: In hoc casu, oculus sinistrum et cerebrum Lato Guiaro indubie puncta vitalia erant.

source: His remaining eye widened and protruded, life force rapidly draining as he slumped to the ground.
target: Oculus eius reliquus dilatatus et eminent, vis vitae celeriter defluens, dum ad terram labefactatus est.

source: Lumian seized Ultraman’s neck, lifting him up.
target: Lumian collum Ultraman apprehendit, eum levans.

source: Releasing his right hand, which held the black bone flute, he delivered a heavy slap to Lato Guiaro’s face.
target: Manum dextram dimittens, quae tibiam ossis nigrae tenebat, gravem percussum in faciem Lato Guiaro attulit.

source: With a fierce expression, he growled in Intisian, “Did you go to Cordu Village to confirm the situation?”
target: Vultu feroci, in lingua Intisiana, rugivit: “Ad Vicum Cordu ivistine ut rem comprobares?”
